turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I understand you disagree with the decision on your damage claim. I have passed your case to a colleague, who will take over from here and review it with you.

input.summary: Customer rejects staff's decision to close their earlier damage claim. Staff said the pale patches are part of the drawing. Customer is not yet verified (no order number or email given), so no order details were checked. Please contact the customer to review the decision.
